description: UNAVAILABLE: Loads the whole literature table (hundreds of millions of rows) into pandas and returns rows in file order. A sidecar index over pmid and keywordId arrives in phase 4.; use pubmed.search_pubmed, association.get_evidence_by_publication. Search publication metadata.

keyword_id.description: Accepts literature_word, ensembl_gene, ot_disease, chembl_molecule; resolved to one literature_word (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

pmid.description: Accepts pmid; resolved to one pmid (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
